notes:
- **Bring in what ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini knows about you.** Paste its answer on the Memory screen,
  tick the lines to keep, and your agent starts from them. A line with a password, a card number or
  a Social Security number is never kept. You can also change any memory line in place.
- **Open Archie from any app** with Control, Shift and Space on a Mac, or Ctrl, Alt and Space on
  Windows. Change the keys in Settings, under General. On a Mac, Archie also has an icon in the menu
  bar.
- **Calendar invitations with people and a place**, on Google and Outlook calendars, after your yes
  like every calendar change. The card names everyone who will get an invitation.
- **Your agent can see when other people are busy**, never what they are doing, when it looks for a
  time, on Google and on a work or school Outlook account. On Google, reconnect first: on the
  Connections tab, under Email, calendar, files, press Reconnect on your Google account, keep Let it
  change events ticked, and sign in with Google again.
- **Stop asking about your own calendar.** After you say yes to three changes, the card offers Yes,
  and stop asking. From then on, adding or moving an event only you are on happens at once, with
  Undo over the message box. Deleting, inviting and every reply still wait for you.
- **Charts in the chat.** Ask for a comparison and your agent can draw bars, a line or a pie.
- **Search this chat** with the Search this chat button or Command F (Ctrl F on Windows), and on
  Archie Mobile.
- **Talk over your agent to stop it** on the talk screen, and the chat marks where it stopped.
- **Your agent can phone a business for you**, if you want it to. It is off until you switch on
  Call businesses on your agent's Setup tab, under What it can do, and paste a key from your own
  Bland account, which bills you by the minute. Your agent shows you a card first, and only your
  press on Place the call dials. Businesses only, never a person you know.
- **A line over the message box says what changed and what went out today.**
- **A line under a reply says what your agent read to answer it.**
- **A draft says what it added and where that came from**, and offers Write like me on the card.
- **Keep a list matched to its spreadsheet**, or to a Google Sheet shared with your agent, from the
  import screen. Archie checks the file every minute and before the morning list.
- **The morning list puts what needs your decision first**, and says where a booking and your
  calendar disagree.
- **Email Manager and Package Tracker ask before they read your inbox.** Nothing new is read until
  you press Start reading my mail.
- **Ask where your information goes and you get a straight yes or no first.**
- **The Routines tab says routines run on this computer**, and that one due while it sleeps runs
  when it wakes.
- **On Archie for Teams, your agent uses a teammate's own phone and email when they are the one
  asking**, tells you what a teammate saved, and lets a teammate answer their own cards from their
  phone.
- **The daily briefing sends nothing on a day with nothing on the calendar.**
